features.name: Custom user model with email login
features.description: Employee model (AbstractUser) with email as username, roles (Hiring Manager, Manager, Recruiter, Interviewer) and levels (Junior..Head)

features.name: JWT authentication
features.description: simplejwt with refresh rotation, blacklist after rotation, last_login update

features.name: Role-based object permissions
features.description: Per-app permission classes: only assigned interviewers score, recruiters create evaluations, approvers vote/approve working forms

features.name: Question bank with topics and tech stacks
features.description: Questions with difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard), source tracking (template/added/changed/AI-generated), usage counters, soft delete

features.name: Projects, Topics, TechStacks CRUD
features.description: Reference data apps with is_active soft deletion and admin integration

features.name: Reusable interview templates
features.description: TemplateForm groups topics and question snapshots; unique slug generation; read-only admin proxies

features.name: Draft / publish workflow for templates
features.description: Unpublished changes stored in draft_data JSON; publish applies them so in-use templates stay stable

features.name: Working forms cloned from templates
features.description: Per-vacancy form with level, project, interviewers, recruiters, hiring manager; auto-generated unique name/slug with sequence numbers

features.name: Approval workflow with voting-based deletion
features.description: Approvers vote to remove topics/questions (EffectiveDeletionMixin); form approved when all approvers sign off; soft delete with history

features.name: Real-time collaboration over WebSockets
features.description: Channels + Redis consumer broadcasting votes, approvals, added topics/questions; JWT WebSocket auth middleware

features.name: Candidate evaluation forms
features.description: Snapshot clone of approved working form per candidate with interview datetime and status lifecycle (pending/in_progress/completed)

features.name: Per-question scoring and interviewer feedback
features.description: Scores 0-3 per interviewer per question with comments and lacks_expertise flag; final feedback (pros/cons/decision/level) with submit lock

features.name: HTML evaluation report generation
features.description: Static HTML report rendered on completion and stored in media/reports

features.name: PeopleForce CRM sync
features.description: Evaluation summary, decision and report link posted as a note to the candidate card via PeopleForce API

features.name: Celery background processing
features.description: Worker + beat (DB scheduler) + Flower; periodic task auto-transitions evaluation status pending -> in_progress 1h before interview

features.name: Dockerized environment
features.description: docker-compose with app (Daphne/ASGI), PostgreSQL 16, Redis, Celery worker/beat, Flower; wait_for_db command

features.name: OpenAPI documentation
features.description: drf-spectacular schema with Swagger UI and ReDoc

features.name: Modern admin panel
features.description: django-unfold theme, nested inlines, read-only proxy models

features.name: API hygiene
features.description: Pagination, anon/user throttling, django-filter, nested routers for working-form topics/items

features.name: Test suite
features.description: Unit + API tests for services, permissions, cloning logic, WebSocket consumers; coverage reporting (tests are currently placeholders)

features.name: CI/CD pipeline
features.description: GitHub Actions: lint (flake8/black), tests, migration check, build & deploy

features.name: AI question generation and selection
features.description: Generate/suggest questions by tech stack, topic, level and past usage; Question.source=GENERATED already reserved in the model

features.name: AI-assisted scoring
features.description: Suggested score and rationale from interviewer notes/transcript; interviewer always confirms

features.name: Note-taker integration with independent AI answer scoring
features.description: Interview transcript from a note-taker (Recall.ai / Fireflies) mapped to form questions; AI independently scores each candidate answer on the same 0-3 scale

features.name: Divergence report (AI vs interviewer scores)
features.description: Per-question comparison of AI and interviewer scores with rationale; used for interview quality control and interviewer calibration

features.name: AI interview summary
features.description: Auto-generated candidate summary from scores, comments and feedback for report and CRM note

features.name: Candidate interview memory
features.description: Persistent history of all interviews per candidate with embeddings (pgvector); avoid repeated questions, surface past strengths/weaknesses

features.name: Recruitment analytics
features.description: Funnel metrics, time-to-hire, pass rates by vacancy/tech stack/interviewer, question difficulty calibration

features.name: HR analytics
features.description: Interviewer load and consistency, hiring quality tracking, panel diversity, dashboards for hiring managers

features.name: L&D foundation
features.description: Reuse question bank and scoring engine for internal skill assessments, competency matrices, growth plans and re-evaluation cycles

features.name: Email / in-app notifications
features.description: Interview reminders, approval requests, feedback deadline notifications (TODO already noted in tasks.py)

features.name: Calendar integration
features.description: Google/Outlook calendar events for scheduled interviews with conflict detection

features.name: PDF report export
features.description: PDF version of the evaluation report alongside HTML; secure signed URLs instead of public media links

features.name: Audit log
features.description: Structured audit trail of form changes, votes, approvals and score edits

features.name: Environment-split settings and hardening
features.description: settings/base|dev|prod, ALLOWED_HOSTS/CORS from env, S3-compatible media storage, Sentry, structured logging

features.name: API versioning and response caching
features.description: /api/v1/ namespace, Redis caching for reference data, ETag support

features.name: SPA frontend
features.description: React/Next.js client: template builder, live working-form collaboration UI, evaluation cockpit, analytics dashboards
